name: Beads UI
description: Your beads tasks beside your agents, and full screen in the middle of Orca: see what moves, change any task in place, and hand one to an agent in one press.

cover.alt: Beads UI for Orca: its logo and name beside the full-screen board, with the side panel in dark in front of it.

screenshots.caption: New in 2.0: the whole board full screen in the middle of Orca; drag a card to start, hold or finish it.
screenshots.alt: The full-screen board with To do, In progress, Awaiting review, Blocked and Done columns, and filters above them.

screenshots.caption: The list one line per task with filters, and a task on its own page with its properties on the right.
screenshots.alt: The full-screen list in dark grouped by state, and a task page in light with its description, criteria and properties.

screenshots.caption: In progress on top, then what can start, what waits and what is done; epics with their progress.
screenshots.alt: Two Beads panels: the All tab grouped by state with To do unfolded, and the Epics tab in dark with an epic's tasks and progress bar.

screenshots.caption: Every field is a menu: status, priority, assignee, type, parent, labels, dates and estimate.
screenshots.alt: A task in the Beads panel with its priority menu open, next to the same task in dark scrolled to its criteria, links and comments.

screenshots.caption: Start hands a task to Claude Code, Codex or any enabled agent, in this worktree or a new one.
screenshots.alt: The Start menu listing Claude Code and Codex, and the task in dark once Claude Code was launched on it.

screenshots.caption: The beads memory every agent gets when its session starts: read it, add to it, rewrite or forget a fact.
screenshots.alt: The Memory view listing four facts with a search field, and the same view in dark writing a new memory.
